item.title: At Dara Restaurant, Thai chef shares cultural flavors & some of her grandma's recipes
item.description: Dara Restaurant has been open just over a year and it's already famous for its hor mok. It's a truly authentic Thai dish made with a mix of seafood, homemade red curry, coconut milk and egg. It's decorated with the Thai flag and served inside a fresh coconut. Chef Wichittra Phansaeng grew up in Thailand, cooking with her grandmother since she was a young girl.

item.title: Insatiable by Chef Denise a lifelong dream for owner

item.title: The National Constitution Center's 19th Amendment exhibit explains how women won the right to vote
item.description: The National Constitution Center's 19th Amendment exhibit explains how women won the right to vote. You can see the tactics they used to win public favor, join the parade for suffrage and see a jailhouse pin with a heart padlock that was gifted to the women arrested for fighting for their rights.
